name: AdaptiveSmartManager
description: Adaptive Smart Manager v0.1.0-test23: reads 3.0 Process goals, consumed inputs and speed conversion for finite CPU/GPU demand; refreshes dynamic requirements. Retains test22 unlock compatibility, manager ids, settings and distribution policies.

godot.description_rich: Adaptive Smart Manager unifies Smart Thread and Smart GPU Manager while preserving their player-facing behavior, fixing runtime bugs, and exposing a read-only AAC compatibility surface.
